answer: Proposal: each rewarded key leases an exclusive orchard weather plot for 60 days; a tundra reference station supplies regional pressure. Independent inspectors certify plot IDs and surprise-audit meters. During a gale, auditors challenge all meters at once for signed local gust traces. Proposed validators deny duplicate plots or missing traces; a failed field audit of forged traces slashes the meter bond. A farm can rent plots and share code, but k keys need k occupied sites and meters for 60 days; borrowing cash cannot make one plot serve two keys.
